description: A regtest chain captured whole as the DRS-E2 replay pair. corpus.e2: every block 0..=tip_height with the FULL bytes of every listed transaction (shekyl-chain-replay fetch, RD-F15-verified). trace.e2: the Rust baseline (shekyl-chain-replay baseline): the corpus replayed against a fresh store, then each height's facts and the tip's digest and archival rows read off it, pinned at built_at_dev_sha. A regression gate, not a conformance oracle. Consumed by replay: shekyl-chain-ingest connects the chain against a real store, so the state the 4.I rules read is derived, not asserted. Regenerate with SHEKYL_CAPTURE_CHAIN_VECTORS=1, SHEKYL_PINNED_REGEN_DECISION="YYYY-MM-DD <rationale>" citing DAEMON_REDB_STORE.md §12.1, SHEKYLD_BIN and SHEKYL_CHAIN_REPLAY_BIN set to binaries built at that same HEAD, running the named generator --ignored.
regen_decision: 2026-11-04 The derivation salt is name_id || purpose (V3_WALLET_DECISION_LOG.md 2026-11-04; DAEMON_REDB_STORE.md §12.1): regtest's genesis moved, the capturable chains re-captured
